## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run coverage`

- [ ] Python checks, if `python/` changed
- [ ] Integration checks, if `integrations/` changed

## Release Impact

- [ ] API, CLI, capsule, or package compatibility is unchanged
- [ ] Breaking changes include migration notes and changelog updates
- [ ] Security or untrusted-input changes update `SECURITY.md`
- [ ] Browser-harness remains optional interop only
